lines.zh: 我绕着界王星的小屋走
lines.en: I walk circles around my little house
The sea of clouds churns below
Hands behind my back, I pace slowly
A tiny star orbits around me

lines.zh: 我走到院子那头再回来
lines.en: I walk to the far end of the yard and back

lines.zh: 界王星的草地只有几步宽
lines.en: The grass of King Kai's planet is a few steps wide
The ground bounces a little under me
I walk and think about Goku
The King's steps are a little smug
That is my third lap

lines.zh: 我盘腿坐着，比你想象中稳
lines.en: I sit cross-legged, steadier than you think
I look up at the snake way

lines.zh: 我在算今天的重力训练
lines.en: I am planning today's gravity training
I hold my chin and say nothing

lines.zh: 云海的风吹过我的天线
lines.en: The cloud wind passes over my antenna
I doze with half-open eyes
Even a King has his idle moments

lines.zh: 我盯着虚空里的一个点
lines.en: I stare at a point in the void

lines.zh: 我扶着膝盖换了个坐姿
lines.en: I shift my sitting position, hands on my knees

lines.zh: 我在等下一个来学艺的
lines.en: I am waiting for the next student

lines.zh: 我用手敲着膝盖打拍子
lines.en: I tap a rhythm on my knee
Thunder rolls over the cloud sea

lines.zh: 我在心里排着弟子名单
lines.en: I run through my list of students
I move my teacup beside the stone
A King has endless patience
Well, a student has come
You stand before me, so what will you learn
Not so fast, a King is busy

lines.zh: 你身上有气，我感觉得到
lines.en: You carry ki, I can feel it
I smile, eyes narrowing
To grow strong, learn to tell a joke
Which road did you take here
Do not tread on my grass
Your ki is still too crude
I size you up, head to toe
Relax, I do not eat people
Ouch, the King is wounded
This frame of mine rarely takes hits
Who has the nerve for this
I straighten up, holding my waist
This wound will not stop the jokes
I bare my teeth at the ache
Pain, on King Kai's planet

lines.zh: 北界王的袍子，被风吹旧了。
lines.en: North Kai's robe is worn by the wind.
I rub my shoulder
Next training is doubled
What food is that
There is nothing good to eat on King Kai's planet
I caught the smell of something good
You bring food to your master
I am quite picky, you know
Let me taste it first, then we talk training

lines.zh: 这味道不像是界王星出的
lines.en: This does not come from King Kai's planet
Do not shake your hand, pass it here

lines.zh: 我可以为此少讲一个笑话
lines.en: For this I will skip one joke
You bumped into the King
This small frame cannot take much
Plant your feet a little steadier
We are squeezed onto these few steps of ground
You knocked my antenna crooked
It is nothing, stop apologizing

lines.zh: 你再撞一下我就加练你
lines.en: Bump me again and I will add to your training
The ground bounced
I raise a hand to stop you
Watch where you walk, kid
A King does not discuss that

lines.zh: 我孤家寡人守着这颗小星球
lines.en: I keep this little planet alone
The cloud sea holds my old stories
I steer the subject elsewhere
Training matters more than that
I clear that breath in my throat
Your curiosity is too heavy
I shake my head and laugh
There is much a King cannot say
Let us talk about ki instead

lines.zh: 这石头在界王星上也算宝贝
lines.en: On this planet even a stone is a treasure
I tuck it into my sleeve
Whatever falls here is under my care
I pick up a fallen leaf
This will do as a prop for a joke
I bend down slowly to pick it up
I sweep the crumbs aside
This thing is somewhat interesting
I have put it away, do not ask
A strong ki is approaching
I lift my eyes that way
This is no ordinary visitor
I straighten up and drop the smile
The King will watch this
You had better not move
I sense killing intent
My antenna stands up
I know this presence
Trouble has plainly arrived
I raise my palm, ki in the center
Something is about to happen here
I stand in front of the house

lines.zh: 我不喜欢在草地上打架
lines.en: I dislike fighting on my grass
This ki came too fast
I narrow my eyes to trace where it came from
First I steady my footing

lines.zh: 传说级的人物也会紧张
lines.en: Even legends get nervous
I keep watching that direction
Its ki has not settled

lines.zh: 我慢慢后退半步护住屋子
lines.en: I edge back half a step to guard the house
King Kai's planet cannot take a fight
I am judging how strong it is
I have felt this ki before
I lower my center
It has not stopped once
I will not strike, but I will not run
I wait for it to speak first
I draw my ki slowly inward
It seems to be testing me
I make no unnecessary movement
My antenna keeps twitching
This cloud sea is too narrow
I count its breaths

lines.zh: 我教过很多人怎么面对恐惧
lines.en: I have taught many how to face fear
I am waiting for an opening
It does not move, so neither do I
I plant my feet firmly
I raise my palm once to block
Even a King will fight
I pushed you aside
This palm of mine is not heavy
Do not make me raise my ki
My antenna swayed
Ki gathered in my palm for an instant
I blocked it, but did not strike back
This planet is too small, do not be reckless
I flick it away with a fingertip
I kept seven parts of my strength back
Do not run wild on King Kai's planet
I step forward and block you
I come down from above the cloud sea
King Kai's planet is turning again
I am the Kai who rules these clouds
This little planet is under my care
The cloud sea spreads out beneath me
I brush the dust off my robe
The snake way is over there, look carefully

lines.zh: 一百点生命，够我慢慢教
lines.en: A hundred health is enough for slow teaching
My antenna pokes out of the clouds first
Another era is about to begin

lines.zh: 云海被我踩出一圈涟漪
lines.en: My landing sends ripples across the clouds
I shake out my wide robe
Remember the King's rules

lines.zh: 我在这颗小星球上等了很多年
lines.en: I have waited many years on this little planet
I put my hands behind my back

lines.zh: 这条蛇道通向很多地方
lines.en: This snake way leads to many places
I am about to start teaching again
I walk to the middle of the yard
My laughter arrives before I do
The gravity here suits me fine
Fire caught my robe
I dropped a stretch through the clouds
The cloud sea poured into my nose

lines.zh: 爆风把我的屋子吹歪了
lines.en: The blast tilted my house
A ki blast grazed me

lines.zh: 这股邪气钻进我的骨头
lines.en: This evil ki crawled into my bones
There really is nothing to eat on King Kai's planet
Lightning struck my antenna
I was thrown into the void
